note: Append-only. Each entry carries the hash of the one before it. The log proves nothing about events before entry 1.

anchor.how_to_check: Each head hash below is published in this file, which is committed to a public git repository. Find the commit that introduced a given head and read its server-side timestamp. That timestamp is not under the issuer's control.

entries.subject: commitment log opened
entries.claim: This log begins now. It proves nothing about any run, bar or bank that predates entry 1, and no past result should be read as strengthened by it.

entries.subject: Arcifact Gate analyser cli.py
entries.claim: The exact analyser bytes used for every Gate finding issued from this date. A later finding claiming this version must recompute to this digest.

entries.subject: Gate expression engine gexpr.py
entries.claim: The expression evaluator that decides fail-open predicates. Committed separately because a change here changes what the analyser can conclude.

entries.subject: arcifact-report/1 envelope schema
entries.claim: The record format every instrument emits. Committed so a future record cannot claim conformance to a schema that was quietly altered.

entries.subject: Gate finding bar, from this date
entries.claim: A Gate finding is only reported as a proven gap when: the gate is an enforced required check resolved from a supplied required-check list; the uncovered job is not in needs, not reachable to the gate, and has no inspected dependent; the job is not marked continue-on-error; and the finding reproduces in both exact and closure modes. Anything else is reported as advisory, unresolved, or not analysed.
